description: This file defines a Mongoose schema and model for storing application deployment data in a MongoDB collection 'app_deployments'. It includes fields for deployment metadata such as app ID, URLs, build information, status, and related timestamps, as well as index definitions for efficient querying.

classes.name: AppDeploymentsSchema
classes.description: A Mongoose schema that specifies the structure and indexes for the 'app_deployments' collection, including fields related to application deployment details and indexing strategies.

methods.name: mongoose.model
methods.description: Creates and exports a Mongoose model named 'AppDeployment' based on the defined schema.
